notes.title: Check out our Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Sikanda is now on Kickstarter! We plan to offer [b]Early Access[/b] to all backers in March 2019, with public Early Access coming in June 2019. The final game is planned to be released on February 28th, 2020. Please help us to make this come true!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dyadicgames/sikanda-3d-fantasy-action-adventure-for-nintendo-s]Support us on Kickstarter![/url]
